name: com.ownid.sdk.internal.feature.flow.steps.webapp.OwnIdWebAppActivity
description: When an OwnID sign-in or verification flow needs a browser page, this Activity opens it in the user's browser and returns the browser result to the app. It runs while the user completes that web step.
disableEffect: OwnID sign-in or verification steps that require the browser handoff will not finish.
